title: Fix CAD Gizmo Press Transition
description: When pressing the CAD projection gizmo incorrectly nothing happens. Ensure every gizmo press transitions the camera properly, including presses that currently resolve to the active projection spec.
summary: Fixed CAD navigation-gizmo presses being discarded when the selected projection spec structurally matched the stored spec. Every press now enters the shared 280 ms projection snap pipeline, allowing a repeated target to restore a camera moved by orbit controls. Added an in-file regression test for repeated Top selection. Verified with bun nx test @semio-tech/infinite-world-r3f (2 files, 200 tests) and live in CAD: two consecutive presses on the same center target each emitted a gizmo hit and completed projection snap under temporary [DEBUG] instrumentation, which was removed afterward.
